history.subject: HIGH RISK OUTBREAK ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) in Baramati, Pune
history.message:
HIGH RISK OUTBREAK ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) in Baramati, Pune

High-Risk Outbreak Containment Notice

URGENT BIOSECURITY ALERT


A cluster of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) with 14 cases has been identified in Baramati, Pune.


Mandatory Biosecurity Directives:

Quarantine infected cattle and restrict livestock movement outside the 5km containment perimeter.


Report any unexplained fever, salivation, or vesicular lesions immediately to Emergency Line 1962.

Emergency Helpline: 1962
JeevRakshak AI - Govt of Maharashtra

Your Farmer account has been registered successfully on JeevRakshak AI, the Maharashtra State Livestock Disease Surveillance & Management System.


Key Features Available:

• Real-time regional disease outbreak alerts for your area (District / Taluka / Village).

• Automated vaccination reminder schedule with booster countdowns.
